EN:
Are you sure you wish to abandon your settlement?
All items, resources stashed as well as buildings will be lost.
PTBR:
Tem certeza de que deseja abandonar seu assentamento?
Todos os itens, recursos armazenados e edifícios serão perdidos.

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Humans were the most common being in the world once, but these days are long gone. The population decimated by constant wars is now just a shadow of its former glory. Representatives of this race are extremely adaptable to the situation, but their history was marked heavily by external influence. As the War of Worlds has ended, a great empire has been formed, where single human family clings to the seat of power to this day.[/color]

All statistics +1
Gets hungry 50% slower

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Knife, Bandage
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Fishing rod
race.name: Human

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Dark dwarves are a subrace of dwarves completely corrupted by greed. They prefer to build their incredible keeps very deep below the ground or near volcanoes. Beings of these race are known for being cruel and malevolent.[/color]

Endurance +2
Willpower +2
Infravision: see in the dark.
Tinkerer: double chance to learn new recipe when salvaging.

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Pickaxe, Belt
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Pickaxe
race.name: Dark dwarf

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Goblins are small greenskin creatures known for their ruthlessness. Some say they are shorter orc cousins. They form tribes and prefer to live in the mountains. Their greed pushes them to challenge dwarves for their territory constantly. From time to time, they organize in hordes that swarm even the human empire.[/color]

Dexterity +3, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Sneaking +10

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Rags
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Rags
race.name: Goblin

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]A long time ago dark elves were living in the forests with their brethren, but they were corrupted by dark gods. Now they occupy huge underground cities. Their controversial religious practices and rituals make them feared and dreaded. They despise most other races for opposing their rightful place among them.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Intelligence +1, Willpower +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Sight range +1

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Dagger
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Short bow
race.name: Dark elf

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Vampires are dead beings of living races, cursed to wander the world till the end of times. They don't eat regular food and don't drink water. They feed by drinking the blood of the living to sustain their immortal bodies. Vampires have formed an enclave in the ruins of Black Sun Castle, where they scheme to take over the world and enslave the living like cattle.[/color]

Strength +1, Endurance +2, Intelligence +1
Thirst and hunger is replaced by bloodlust.
Infravision: see in the dark.

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Cloak, Hood
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Cloak
race.name: Vampire

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Trolls are huge humanoid beasts. Not many beings of this race are considered smart, but they make up for it with brutal, physical power. Trolls have the strength to tear smaller beings apart in the blink of an eye. They are forever hungry and possess very potent regenerative powers.[/color]

Strength +3, Endurance +1, Intelligence -2
Regenerates health 20% faster.
Gets hungry 50% faster.

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Club
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Club
race.name: Troll

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Orcs are green. Orcs are mean. Orcs want to smash, bash and eat. They form hordes led by the most brutal chieftains of their kind to raid other races for loot. Their physical appearance is second only to trolls and giants.[/color]

Strength +2, Endurance +2
Hit bonus +1 on all weapons

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Hand axe
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Hatchet
race.name: Orc

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Liches are powerful mages that cheated death. There are not many of them in the world, but most are immensely powerful. Their center of power is in the Black Pyramid of Sareth where God Pharaoh Sandaver rules over the dead. The power that allows these beings to defy death is shrouded in mystery.[/color]

Intelligence +2, Willpower +2
Thirst and hunger is replaced by life essence.
Death aura dealing 1 death damage to everything nearby every turn.

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Quarterstaff
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Mask
race.name: Lich

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Rasimi are cat-like people. They are many sub-races among them, having common parts with lions, panthers, tigers or regular house cats. They live deep in the jungles of Tar'Var. They are individuals, loners and prefer seclusion over contact with others, as they considering other races untrustworthy. The feeling is often mutual.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Strength +1, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Move 10% faster

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Dagger, Shirt
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Dagger
race.name: Rasimi

Their controversial religious practices and rituals make them feared and dreaded. They despise most other races for opposing their rightful place among them.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Intelligence +1, Willpower +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Sight range +1

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Dagger
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Short bow
race.name: Dark elf

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Vampires are dead beings of living races, cursed to wander the world till the end of times. They don't eat regular food and don't drink water. They feed by drinking the blood of the living to sustain their immortal bodies. Vampires have formed an enclave in the ruins of Black Sun Castle, where they scheme to take over the world and enslave the living like cattle.[/color]

Strength +1, Endurance +2, Intelligence +1
Thirst and hunger is replaced by bloodlust.
Infravision: see in the dark.

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Cloak, Hood
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Cloak
race.name: Vampire

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Trolls are huge humanoid beasts. Not many beings of this race are considered smart, but they make up for it with brutal, physical power. Trolls have the strength to tear smaller beings apart in the blink of an eye. They are forever hungry and possess very potent regenerative powers.[/color]

Strength +3, Endurance +1, Intelligence -2
Regenerates health 20% faster.
Gets hungry 50% faster.

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Club
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Club
race.name: Troll

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Orcs are green. Orcs are mean. Orcs want to smash, bash and eat. They form hordes led by the most brutal chieftains of their kind to raid other races for loot. Their physical appearance is second only to trolls and giants.[/color]

Strength +2, Endurance +2
Hit bonus +1 on all weapons

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Hand axe
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Hatchet
race.name: Orc

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Liches are powerful mages that cheated death. There are not many of them in the world, but most are immensely powerful. Their center of power is in the Black Pyramid of Sareth where God Pharaoh Sandaver rules over the dead. The power that allows these beings to defy death is shrouded in mystery.[/color]

Intelligence +2, Willpower +2
Thirst and hunger is replaced by life essence.
Death aura dealing 1 death damage to everything nearby every turn.

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Quarterstaff
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Mask
race.name: Lich

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Rasimi are cat-like people. They are many sub-races among them, having common parts with lions, panthers, tigers or regular house cats. They live deep in the jungles of Tar'Var. They are individuals, loners and prefer seclusion over contact with others, as they considering other races untrustworthy. The feeling is often mutual.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Strength +1, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Move 10% faster

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Dagger, Shirt
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Dagger

EN:
To generate some wealth from long distance trading, choose up to 4 resources from your stash, target settlement and unoccupied NPC to lead the caravan.

From time to time, families will send their own caravans to distant lands. These caravans move resources to other settlements and produce wealth for the families.
PTBR:
Para gerar riqueza com comércio de longa distância, escolha até 4 recursos do seu estoque, o assentamento de destino e um NPC desocupado para liderar a caravana.

De tempos em tempos, as famílias enviarão suas próprias caravanas a terras distantes. Essas caravanas movem recursos para outros assentamentos e geram riqueza para as famílias.

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Vampires are dead beings of living races, cursed to wander the world till the end of times. They don't eat regular food and don't drink water. Vampires have formed an enclave in the ruins of Black Sun Castle, where they scheme to take over the world and enslave the living like cattle.[/color]

Thirst and hunger is replaced by bloodlust.
Infravision: see in the dark.

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Trolls are huge humanoid beasts. Not many beings of this race are considered smart, but they make up for it with brutal, physical power. Strength +3, Endurance +1, Intelligence -2

[color=155,155,155,255]Liches are powerful mages that cheated death. There are not many of them in the world, but most are immensely powerful. The feeling is often mutual.[/color]

Infravision: see in the dark.
Move 10% faster

Thirst and hunger is replaced by life essence.
Death aura dealing 1 death damage to everything nearby every turn.

They live deep in the jungles of Tar'Var. They are individuals, loners and prefer seclusion over contact with others, as they considering other races untrustworthy. The feeling is often mutual.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Strength +1, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Move 10% faster

Their center of power is in the Black Pyramid of Sareth where God Pharaoh Sandaver rules over the dead. The power that allows these beings to defy death is shrouded in mystery.[/color]

Intelligence +2, Willpower +2
Thirst and hunger is replaced by life essence.
Death aura dealing 1 death damage to everything nearby every turn.

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Rasimi are cat-like people. They are many sub-races among them, having common parts with lions, panthers, tigers or regular house cats. They live deep in the jungles of Tar'Var. They are individuals, loners and prefer seclusion over contact with others, as they considering other races untrustworthy. The feeling is often mutual.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Strength +1, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Move 10% faster

EN:
Here you can trade with specific settlement family.

Each family member has access to shared family inventory.
- The [color=98,116,133,255]>[/color] button allows you to put 1 item for sell.
- The [color=98,116,133,255]>>[/color] button allow you to put 10 items for sell.
- Similary, pressing the [color=98,116,133,255]<[/color] or [color=98,116,133,255]<<[/color] buttons allow you to buy form family.
- Holding [color=98,116,133,255]ctrl (Keyboard)[/color] or [color=98,116,133,255]LB (Gamepad)[/color] while hovering [color=98,116,133,255]>>[/color] or [color=98,116,133,255]<<[/color] buttons puts all the items in stack for sell.

If you control any settlements, you can change [color=98,116,133,255]'To Backpack'[/color] to different destination for the goods that you buy.

[color=98,116,133,255]'Trade'[/color] button finalizes the transaction.
PTBR:
Aqui você pode negociar com uma família específica do povoado.

Cada membro da família tem acesso ao inventário compartilhado da família.
- O [color=98,116,133,255]>[/color] botão permite colocar 1 item à venda.
- O [color=98,116,133,255]>>[/color] botão permite colocar 10 itens à venda.
- Da mesma forma, pressionar os [color=98,116,133,255]<[/color] ou [color=98,116,133,255]<<[/color] botões permite comprar da família.
- Segurar [color=98,116,133,255]ctrl (Teclado)[/color] ou [color=98,116,133,255]LB (Controle)[/color] enquanto passar o mouse sobre [color=98,116,133,255]>>[/color] ou [color=98,116,133,255]<<[/color] botões coloca todos os itens da pilha à venda.

Se você controlar algum povoado, pode alterar [color=98,116,133,255]'Para a Mochila'[/color] para um destino diferente para os itens que comprar.

[color=98,116,133,255]'Negociar'[/color] botão finaliza a transação.

EN:
Here you can safely stash your items.

- The [color=98,116,133,255]>[/color] button allows you to put 1 item to stash.
- The [color=98,116,133,255]>>[/color] button allow you to put x10 items to stash.
- Similary, pressing the [color=98,116,133,255]<[/color] or [color=98,116,133,255]<<[/color] buttons allow you to take items from stash.
- Holding [color=98,116,133,255]ctrl (Keyboard)[/color] or [color=98,116,133,255]LB (Gamepad)[/color] while hovering [color=98,116,133,255]>>[/color] or [color=98,116,133,255]<<[/color] buttons allows you to move entire item stack.

On the bottom you can see [color=207,181,59,255]transfer gold coin icon[/color], which allows you to transfer gold to settlement stash or withdraw gold from it.

If you have items in stash within controlled settlement, remember that NPC can buy items from your stash.

You can [color=98,116,133,255]lock items[/color] in Settlement Screen.

If you're playing on Dark Fantasy difficulty mode, items left in settlement stash persist, however access to private stash is only inherited by direct descendants.

They feed by drinking the blood of the living to sustain their immortal bodies. Vampires have formed an enclave in the ruins of Black Sun Castle, where they scheme to take over the world and enslave the living like cattle.[/color]

Strength +1, Endurance +2, Intelligence +1
Thirst and hunger is replaced by bloodlust.
Infravision: see in the dark.

They live deep in the jungles of Tar'Var. They are individuals, loners and prefer seclusion over contact with others, as they considering other races untrustworthy. The feeling is often mutual.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Strength +1, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Move 10% faster

[color=155,155,155,255]Humans were the most common being in the world once, but these days are long gone. The population decimated by constant wars is now just a shadow of its former glory. race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Goblins are small greenskin creatures known for their ruthlessness. Some say they are shorter orc cousins. They form tribes and prefer to live in the mountains. Dexterity +3, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]A long time ago dark elves were living in the forests with their brethren, but they were corrupted by dark gods. Now they occupy huge underground cities. Their controversial religious practices and rituals make them feared and dreaded. They despise most other races for opposing their rightful place among them.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Intelligence +1, Willpower +1
Infravision: see in the dark.

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Vampires are dead beings of living races, cursed to wander the world till the end of times. They don't eat regular food and don't drink water. They feed by drinking the blood of the living to sustain their immortal bodies. Vampires have formed an enclave in the ruins of Black Sun Castle, where they scheme to take over the world and enslave the living like cattle.[/color]

Strength +1, Endurance +2, Intelligence +1
Thirst and hunger is replaced by bloodlust.
Infravision: see in the dark.

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Trolls are huge humanoid beasts. Not many beings of this race are considered smart, but they make up for it with brutal, physical power. Strength +3, Endurance +1, Intelligence -2

[color=155,155,155,255]Liches are powerful mages that cheated death. There are not many of them in the world, but most are immensely powerful. race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Rasimi are cat-like people. They are many sub-races among them, having common parts with lions, panthers, tigers or regular house cats. The feeling is often mutual.[/color]

Infravision: see in the dark.

Their center of power is in the Black Pyramid of Sareth where God Pharaoh Sandaver rules over the dead. The power that allows these beings to defy death is shrouded in mystery.[/color]

Intelligence +2, Willpower +2
Thirst and hunger is replaced by life essence.
Death aura dealing 1 death damage to everything nearby every turn.

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Rasimi are cat-like people. They are many sub-races among them, having common parts with lions, panthers, tigers or regular house cats. The feeling is often mutual.[/color]

Infravision: see in the dark.
Move 10% faster

[color=155,155,155,255]Humans were the most common being in the world once, but these days are long gone. The population decimated by constant wars is now just a shadow of its former glory. All statistics +1
Gets hungry 50% slower

[color=155,155,155,255]Dark dwarves are a subrace of dwarves completely corrupted by greed. They prefer to build their incredible keeps very deep below the ground or near volcanoes. Beings of these race are known for being cruel and malevolent.[/color]

[color=155,155,155,255]Goblins are small greenskin creatures known for their ruthlessness. Some say they are shorter orc cousins. They form tribes and prefer to live in the mountains. Dexterity +3, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]A long time ago dark elves were living in the forests with their brethren, but they were corrupted by dark gods. Now they occupy huge underground cities. Dexterity +2, Intelligence +1, Willpower +1
Infravision: see in the dark.

[color=155,155,155,255]Vampires are dead beings of living races, cursed to wander the world till the end of times. They don't eat regular food and don't drink water. Their greed pushes them to challenge dwarves for their territory constantly. From time to time, they organize in hordes that swarm even the human empire.[/color]

Dexterity +3, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Sneaking +10

Trolls have the strength to tear smaller beings apart in the blink of an eye. They are forever hungry and possess very potent regenerative powers.[/color]

Strength +3, Endurance +1, Intelligence -2
Regenerates health 20% faster.
Gets hungry 50% faster.

They live deep in the jungles of Tar'Var. They are individuals, loners and prefer seclusion over contact with others, as they considering other races untrustworthy. The feeling is often mutual.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Strength +1, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Move 10% faster

[color=155,155,155,255]Vampires are dead beings of living races, cursed to wander the world till the end of times. They don't eat regular food and don't drink water. Trolls have the strength to tear smaller beings apart in the blink of an eye. They are forever hungry and possess very potent regenerative powers.[/color]

Strength +3, Endurance +1, Intelligence -2
Regenerates health 20% faster.
Gets hungry 50% faster.

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Club
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Club
race.name: Troll

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Orcs are green. Orcs are mean. Orcs want to smash, bash and eat. They form hordes led by the most brutal chieftains of their kind to raid other races for loot. Their physical appearance is second only to trolls and giants.[/color]

Strength +2, Endurance +2
Hit bonus +1 on all weapons

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Hand axe
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Hatchet
race.name: Orc

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Liches are powerful mages that cheated death. There are not many of them in the world, but most are immensely powerful. Their center of power is in the Black Pyramid of Sareth where God Pharaoh Sandaver rules over the dead. The power that allows these beings to defy death is shrouded in mystery.[/color]

Intelligence +2, Willpower +2
Thirst and hunger is replaced by life essence.
Death aura dealing 1 death damage to everything nearby every turn.

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Quarterstaff
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Mask
race.name: Lich

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Rasimi are cat-like people. They are many sub-races among them, having common parts with lions, panthers, tigers or regular house cats. They live deep in the jungles of Tar'Var. They are individuals, loners and prefer seclusion over contact with others, as they considering other races untrustworthy. The feeling is often mutual.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Strength +1, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Move 10% faster

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Dagger, Shirt
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Dagger
race.name: Rasimi
